limitations: Inherited SDK lang=tr on English Industrial queries; not language-matched settings.
B CPU and G/E/N NVIDIA L4 bfloat16 results are retained; new S/J local MPS bfloat16 and Laya MPS float32 are separate conditions.
Current byte seals do not retrospectively attest historical embedding generation.
Sixteen-query segmentation is an operational bound; union batching does not establish bitwise equivalence with per-list reranking.

scope.interpretation: Descriptive aggregate differences only; no significance, general winner, confidence interval, p-value or online-latency claim.
scope.paired_difference: Laya minus matching None on the same ordered 283-query cohort, subset and budget. None ranks the full retrieved union; Laya reranks its first K candidates, so differences include the cutoff and reranking.

timing.none_scope: None V5 is CPU derivation over retained rankings; its process wall is not fresh retrieval inference time. Historical retrieval time is not reconstructed from cache access.
timing.process_wall_scope: Monotonic spawn-to-reap duration includes child loading, cleanup, validation, work and startup. It is distinct from scoring-only time. No difference is labeled model reload or cleanup.
timing.score_scope: Sum of successful shared-union adapter score calls with synchronization; excludes loading, cleanup and validation. It is not a per-cell query latency.
